description: NGSC Roads Current is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Northern Grampians Shire Council. Current dataset of road network. September 2019 Polyline data for location of roads registered with council across the Northern Grampians Shire region. Coverage: Northern Grampians Shire Council. The portal files it under the publisher Northern Grampians Shire Council. Its tags are Local goverment, Transportation, asset management, assets, road. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, WFS, WMS, ZIP (SHP). The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
